name: Railcraft High Pressure Boiler
notes: Railcraft high-pressure steam boiler (Railcraft 9.17.31, the version in GTNH 2.9.0-beta-3). A 3x3 solid firebox at the base with high-pressure boiler tanks above it; the height grows with the tank layers (2 to 4). No walls: the structure is only fireboxes and tanks, per the wiki (3x3x3 = 9 fireboxes, 18 tanks). It cannot wallshare and must be at least one block from another boiler. Hatches are not modelled. Only the 3-wide high-pressure boiler is included; 1x1, 2x2 and low-pressure variants are not.
